meta.name: Plicara Labs
meta.note: Generated by tokens/build.py. Edit docs/brand.md, then regenerate.

orange.comment: The one hot colour, and the accent INK of the dark schemes only. On the paper ground it manages 2.3:1, so on light grounds it is a fill and nothing else — that asymmetry is the reason the guard token exists.

rust.comment: Burnt rust. The accent ink on light grounds (9.9:1 on paper) and a facet of the mark. Keeps the token name so nothing downstream has to move.

cream.comment: The identity warm, b* +13.5 — a golden cream, deliberately not a bone: Anthropic's is +4.1. Text on the dark grounds, the guard on rust, and the avatar ground. No longer the page ground; that is paper.

paper.comment: The light ground: the cream's cast at 60% of the saturation (b* +8.2) and 3 L* lighter. Took over page duty from the full-strength cream, which glared at page size (2026-08-23). dE2000 3.8 from Anthropic's bone — above the 2.0 a viewer can resolve.

mist.comment: Raised cool surface on white. Tiles, table rows, code blocks.

duckegg.comment: Pale teal. First chart series on the dark grounds.

smoke.comment: Derived mid. Recessive detail and rules; never body text.

teal.comment: The cool counterweight. Chart series on light grounds; a panel ground on dark.

apricot.comment: Derived: the hot colour lifted. Second chart series on the dark grounds.

sumi.comment: Near-black navy. Primary text on light; the outline colour of every drawing.

night.comment: The primary dark ground. Same value as sumi: the ink and the ground are one colour, which is what makes the cream sit so far forward.

print.comment: Deep teal. Dark ground for benchmarks and tools.

drafting.comment: Raised surface on print. Sits at L*24 and no higher: the accent has to clear 4.5 on top of it.

kraft.comment: Cut paper's light ground: an unbleached sheet, warmer and greyer than paper.

linen.comment: Raised surface on kraft. Code blocks, table tiles.

ink.comment: Warm near-black. Text on kraft and the guard on every light fill.

umber.comment: Cut paper's dark ground: the same sheet under lamplight.

fired.comment: The hot block colour: orange fired a step toward vermilion. A fill only (2.7:1 on kraft), and it holds ink, never cream (2.9:1).

ember.comment: Fired, darkened until it reads as a chart series on kraft (3.9:1).

pine.comment: Deep green. The accent ink on kraft (6.7:1) and a block colour that holds cream.

sage.comment: Pine lifted for the dark ground. First chart series under lamplight.

pink.comment: Soft pink block. Holds ink; second chart series under lamplight.

stone.comment: Neutral paper grey for the not-counted marks in a chart. Never text.

warmwhite.comment: Raised surface on the paper ground. Lighter than the paper, not whiter than it — retuned with the ground, or the two would sit 1 L* apart and every tile would vanish.

display.comment: Variable: opsz 12-24, wght 400. A soft, bookish serif. SIL OFL.

body.comment: Variable: wght 300-900. Geometric sans for body, labels and UI. SIL OFL.

sans.comment: Alias of body, kept so older consumers of --pl-font-sans resolve.
